caseName: United States Postal Service v. National Ass'n of Letter Carriers

attorneys: Glen D. Nager argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs were Solicitor General Fried, Assistant Attorney General Willard, Deputy Solicitor General Wallace, William Kanter, and Marc Richman., Keith E. Secular argued the cause and filed a brief for respondent.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.
